caveats: 3304 of the 3600 region grid cells were sea cells (SST finite on every target day); 296 land cells are set to 0. Threshold/climatology pools used SST from 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05 (baseline years 1992-2002 with the +/-5-day overhang); 90th percentile computed as MATLAB quantile default / numpy method='hazen' (Hyndman-Fan type 5); day 60 = mean of days 59 and 61 before 31-day centred wrap-around smoothing. One regional MHW event detected (2008-06-02 to 2008-06-10).
